description: Known cross-platform drift for react-native (A9.2: recorded, not changed, in this program). `expectations` maps each expectations file (by name) and case file to text that names every field that differs, as "field: why". A conformance test passes a case when react-native matches `expected`, or differs only in a field its entry names; the entry is removed in the change that fixes the drift. `other` records verified drift no expectations case pins. Only the react-native unit edits this file.

other.bridge.android: The Android bridge re-serializes `remote` with ReadableMap.toHashMap(), which turns every JSON integer into a double (48 becomes 48.0). SellwildSDK.apply then sees doubles for integer keys and numeric zone ids.
other.bridge.ios: Resolved in this program; the entry stays only because contracts/test/expectations.test.mjs pins this key (the contracts owner can drop the pin and the entry together). It was: the iOS feed bridge read bannerZid/bottomBannerZid/mobileBannerZid/mobileZids with `as? String` and dropped a number with no report, while the Android feed bridge threw on one (ReadableMap.getString). Now both drop a number and report bridge.config.invalid, and JS sends zone ids as text (nativeConfig.ts nativeZoneId: core's unset 0 is left out, another number is sent as its text). So the iOS feed now uses a non-zero numeric zone id from JS that it dropped before (a behavior change), and no RN bridge drift remains here.
other.bridge.wrongTypedFields: SellwildWidget reports a bridge message field whose type the contract does not allow as bridge.message.invalid, JSON null included (the contract allows no null field, so null is wrong-typed, not absent), and still routes the message as before: a LISTING_CLICK listing that is not an object, or a url that is not text, reaches onListingPress by truthiness (both fields are checked, whichever one routes, and the first wrong one is reported); an AD_IMPRESSION zoneId that is neither text nor a number (null too) reaches onAdImpression; an ERROR message that is not text reaches onError as new Error(message) ('500' for 500, 'null' for null) and is not also reported as bridge.script.exception. Flutter drops such a message after the same report, and treats null as absent: no report, AD_IMPRESSION passes '' and ERROR passes 'Unknown error'.
other.bridge.adImpressionZoneId: An AD_IMPRESSION bridge message with a numeric zoneId (fixtures/bridge-message/valid/ad-impression-number-zone.json) reaches onAdImpression as the number, which its type (string | number) allows. Flutter does not call onAdImpression for it, iOS passes '' and Android the number as text.
other.bridge.listingStub: A LISTING_CLICK with only a url hands onListingPress a stub with every SellwildListing key (empty values, status 'active', currency 'USD', an empty user). Flutter's stub has only id, status, title and url.
other.bridge.geoBoolean: setGeo with a boolean lat, lon or type: the iOS bridge reads it as the number 1 or 0 (SellwildGeo(bridged:) casts `as? NSNumber`, and a boolean is an NSNumber) and reports nothing; the Android bridge drops that field and reports bridge.geo.invalid ('geo.lat is a boolean, not a number, so it was dropped'). Any other wrong-typed geo field is dropped and reported the same way on both.
other.bridge.wrongTypedConfigFields: A config prop field of the wrong type other than the zone ids and prebidServer (for example gamTag as a number, adRefreshMax as text, or a geo field inside config): the iOS view managers drop that field (`as?`) and use the rest of the config, with no report; the Android view managers throw from a ReadableMap getter, report the whole config as bridge.config.invalid (fatal) and set up no ad or feed. setGeo, zone ids and prebidServer are handled the same way on both (dropped and reported).
